summary: God encouraged Gideon with an enemy soldier's dream. Then Gideon's 300 men surrounded the camp at night with trumpets, clay jars, and torches. They blew, smashed, and shouted, and the enemy army fled in confusion.

story_reel.narration: That night, God told Gideon, 'If you're still afraid, sneak down to the enemy camp and listen.' So Gideon and his servant crept to the edge of the camp. They heard one Midianite soldier telling his friend about a dream. 'A round loaf of barley bread came tumbling into our camp. It hit a tent so hard the tent fell flat!' His friend said, 'That's the sword of Gideon! God has given us into his hand!' Gideon bowed down and worshiped God right there. Then he ran back and said, 'Get up! Yahweh has given you the victory!' Gideon gave each of his three hundred men a trumpet and an empty clay jar with a torch hidden inside. In the middle of the night, they surrounded the enemy camp. Gideon said, 'Watch me, and do what I do.' Then they all blew their trumpets, smashed the jars, held up their blazing torches, and shouted, 'The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!' The Midianites woke up to trumpets, crashing, fire, and shouting all around them. They panicked and ran away in confusion! Gideon's men didn't even move from their places. Yahweh had won the battle.

memory_verse.text: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh is on my side, so I don't have to be afraid.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God gave Gideon a special encouragement before the battle. How has God encouraged you when you were afraid?

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You are on my side! Thank You for encouraging me when I'm afraid. I won't be afraid, because You are with me. Amen.

companion.message: Trumpets, smashing jars, and torches! What a strange battle plan. But God's plans always work. Three hundred brave men didn't even have to fight.

review.notes: The rout of Midian (Judges 7:22-25), including the enemy fighting each other and the deaths of Oreb and Zeeb, is shown only as enemies fleeing. Confirm.
